title: Part Type filter opens a Core / Non Core list with Clear selection
permissions_required: Any signed-in user with access to the Parts pages. Whether the filter option lists differ by role is to confirm — pending Branko's PRD.
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. You are on the Parts area of the app with some sample data present.
steps: 1. On the Parts Returns tab, click the Part Type filter button.
2. Look at the small menu that opens.
expected: 1. A small menu opens with two options: Core and Non Core.
2. A Clear selection action is shown at the bottom of the menu.

3. Behaviour to confirm — pending Branko's product write-up; to be checked live once the feature is available. (whether the options are single- or multi-select, and how the list is filtered after choosing).

notes: Design-only (menu contents). Selection/apply behaviour pending Branko's PRD.
